Designs from operational experience, ships with AI, keeps the human at the center. Focus areas: agentic AI, boutique hotel operations, service design, SaaS, open data.

## Status vocabulary

Every component status uses exactly one of these five labels. "Built" means the code runs, not that anyone uses it yet. Canonical source: https://github.com/IvandeMurard/Hospitality-Multi-agent-Architecture/blob/main/llms.txt

- Built - deployed and exercised end-to-end on the target environment.
- Shadow-mode - runs on real data, but no decision is delivered to a human on that basis.
- Synthetic PoC - validated on fabricated data only; never met the real world.
- Design - specified (ADR, schema, contract), not implemented.
- Research - open exploration, no delivery commitment.

## Case studies

- [Aetherix](https://ivandemurard.com/aetherix): The F&B execution agent for boutique hotels. Tomorrow's covers, a staffing grid that fits, and less waste, in one WhatsApp message a day with the reasoning attached. Operational memory is the mechanism that makes the forecast property-specific, not the offer. F&B agent of the Hospitality Agentic Mesh, a five-agent architecture (Aetherix, Tacet, Anima, Peritia, Orchestrator): https://ivandemurard.com/architecture Stack: Apaleo PMS, FastAPI, Prophet, pgvector, HiveMemory (research), Claude Sonnet (Gemini and GPT fallback), MCP Server v0 live on Fly.io.
- [Lore](https://ivandemurard.com/lore): Voice AI mentor for aviation maintenance. Captures what a retiring technician knows and never wrote down, then gives it back to a junior on the shop floor by voice. Three modes: Capture, Query, Log. The procedure always wins, the senior's judgement always arrives attributed by name and month. Built in 24 hours at Speechmatics x AI Collective Paris, Feb 2026, developed solo since. Prototype: synthetic procedures, mock aircraft data, evaluation harness in CI. Stack: Speechmatics real-time STT, OpenAI GPT-4o, Backboard, OpenAI TTS, Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vercel.
- [Anima](https://ivandemurard.com/anima): The guest node of the Hospitality Agentic Mesh. Memory that makes every guest a regular: a guest memory node that anticipates needs, learns from every stay, and improves operations without watching. Under the hood: four memory layers with different lifetimes (working, episodic, semantic, segment), claims carrying a weight, a source and an age that decay unless renewed, and a scope gate so no call returns everything known about a person. It never decides; the orchestrator does, with a human validating. Synthetic proof of concept shipped at an Anthropic hackathon, June 2026. Never run on a real guest, production gated behind a data-protection assessment.
- [Paris Compass](https://paris-compass.lovable.app): Find commercial spaces from their context, built for humans and agents. Compass puts venues back into their neighbourhood: business history, turnover signals, noise, amenities and risk scores, all from public open data. Search by need, not by reference. No case-study page on this site; the live app and the public repo are the reference. Code: https://github.com/IvandeMurard/paris-compass
- [Sonor](https://ivandemurard.com/sonor): Two-year journey as Co-founder & Product Lead. Turned open data into a B2G SaaS used by municipalities to map urban noise and drive sustainability policy.
- [Tacet](https://ivandemurard.com/tacet): Headless Environmental Twin for hospitality, exposed via an MCP server. A 3D ray-tracing physics engine plus a dual memory store (idiosyncratic and hive mind) turns street, weather and crowd signals into human-approved yield rules and Chain of Thought payloads for RMS, PMS and orchestration agents like Aetherix.

## Field Notes

- [Journal index](https://ivandemurard.com/journal)
- [Evaluating LLM agents: how would you know it had stopped working?](https://ivandemurard.com/journal/harnesses-graders-closed-loops) (2026-07-31): A working vocabulary for building evaluation into AI products from day one: case set, grader, harness, protocol, open loop, closed loop. Tested on Aetherix and Lore.
- [A wrong forecast is absorbed. A wrong action reaches a guest.](https://ivandemurard.com/journal/agent-boundaries-aetherix) (2026-04-20): Prophet is a statistical forecasting library. Claude is a large language model. Keeping them as two components, rather than letting one model both predict and act, is the decision that shaped everything after it.
